//: The TypeScript parts of the engine (docs/ENGINEERING.md, 'TypeScript parts'). Sources live under
src-ts/<context>/, mirroring src/; tools/build-ts compiles each one to src/<context>/<name>.js as
CommonJS (a benchmark runner src-ts/bench/<name>.ts to bench/runners/<name>.js) and the compiled
file is committed, so neither an install nor a run needs TypeScript.
'tsc --noEmit' (npm run typecheck) checks the sources; 'npm run check:ts' proves the committed
output is what this compiler writes. Target and lib follow the Node floor of package.json (22.13).
